metadata.title: Entity Linking Gold v1
metadata.description: 200 original synthetic English news mentions produced during Stage 8 automated curation, labelled for ADR 0005 stage-2 entity linking, over a catalog of real, authoritatively-sourced company and product targets. Every context is original to this dataset; no publisher prose, article URL, or source attribution is reproduced. Physically split train=100 / development=50 / final_holdout=50 with no leakage_group or document shared across splits, so a tuned threshold and its held-out score never see the same story.
metadata.split_isolation: Each mention has a unique document and leakage_group; the final_holdout scenarios are distinct from train/development and are gated behind allow_holdout.

labeling.guidelines: ADR 0005 stage-2 labelling: an ORG/PRODUCT mention that refers to a catalog entity is labelled link to that entity's target_id (a brand/subsidiary links to its own target, never to its parent); PERSON/GPE mentions, ordinary-word and place collisions, and organizations/products absent from the catalog are NIL. Assertion status records how the sentence frames the claim (asserted/denied/speculative) and never changes entity identity.
labeling.adjudication: Single automated curation pass validated against the entity_linking_gold v1 contract (schema, offsets, normalization, fixture-UUID, split isolation, and quota checks). No human dual-review or external adjudication was performed; independent verification is pending per the milestone workflow.

license.note: Original synthetic prose authored for this dataset, released CC-BY-4.0. Company and product names, tickers, and identifiers are factual references to their respective owners and are cited to public authoritative registries; no third-party article text or proprietary dataset is included or relicensed.
